channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Justiça Eleitoral suspender pesquisa năo é comum, mas também năo é raro, diz Azevedo Marques
item.description: Minister Floriano de Azevedo Marques of the TSE stated that while it is not common, it is also not rare for the Electoral Justice to suspend the dissemination of electoral polls following challenges by candidates. He noted that such challenges are frequent during campaigns. The remark was made at the Abranet congress in Brasília.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: Lula não vai à missa? Janja rebate Malafaia e PT convoca evangélicos
item.description: The PT released an open letter to evangelicals following the fourth National Meeting of the Party’s Evangelical Nucleus, criticizing pastors and religious leaders aligned with Bolsonarism for using religion as a tool of political manipulation. The document reaffirms the party’s commitment to secularism and religious freedom while seeking to engage with the traditionally conservative evangelical electorate.

item.title: “Lula está quebrando a economia do Brasil”, diz Renan Santos
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Renan Santos (Missão) accused the Lula government of destroying Brazil's economy, citing the rising dollar, increasing inflation, growing expectations for interest rates, and declining economic indicators. He claims the country is already in an ongoing economic crisis and directly blames President Lula for the deterioration of macroeconomic fundamentals.

item.title: Ala do PT-SP deve intensificar pressão por Simone Tebet na vice de Haddad
item.description: A São Paulo PT wing is increasing pressure for Simone Tebet (PSB) to be chosen as Fernando Haddad’s running mate in the gubernatorial race, citing polls showing she draws more votes than Márcio França, along with her ministerial background and gender. Tebet, however, has ruled out the role, stating her focus is on running for Senate, for which she has already changed her electoral domicile and party. Although no meeting with Lula is scheduled, some PT members believe a new conversation with the president could persuade her to reconsider.

item.title: Exército suspende operações na fronteira após bloqueio no orçamento
item.description: The Army suspended specific border operations after President Lula blocked R$4.3 billion in the Defense budget, part of a broader R$23.7 billion cut in discretionary spending required by the fiscal framework. Permanent patrols and surveillance continue uninterrupted. Pre-candidates Flávio Bolsonaro and Ronaldo Caiado criticized the move, claiming it aids organized crime and undermines national sovereignty.

item.title: Conselho de Ética aprova afastamento de Pollon por xingar Motta
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies' Ethics Committee approved a 60-day suspension of Deputy Marcos Pollon (PL-MS) for breaching parliamentary decorum after he called Chamber President Hugo Motta a 'bosta' (a vulgar term) during an August 2025 event. The measure, based on a report by Deputy Ricardo Maia (MDB-BA), passed with 9 votes in favor and 4 against, but will not take effect immediately as Pollon may appeal to the Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ).

item.title: Zanin restabelece condenação de homem que fez comentário racista ao recusar café
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Cristiano Zanin reinstated the racial injury conviction of a man who made racist remarks when refusing coffee offered by a woman in 2019. Zanin overturned the São Paulo Court of Justice's acquittal due to lack of proof of intent, emphasizing that 'recreational racism' cannot be excused as a joke and that the objective content of the speech suffices to constitute the crime.

item.title: O plano de Michelle Bolsonaro para envolver mulheres nas eleições de outubro
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro will launch a PL Women's campaign urging female party members to volunteer as poll workers and supervisors in the October elections, aiming to expand the PL's presence across Brazilian electoral zones. The initiative seeks to offset her withdrawal from PL Women's activities following Jair Bolsonaro's November 2023 imprisonment, keeping the Bolsonaro family active on the ground as a counterweight to the Lula government's women's rights campaigns.

item.title: Motta abre trabalhos e CCJ adia mais uma vez votação de PEC da redução da maioridade penal
item.description: The Chamber’s Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ) once again postponed voting on the PEC to reduce the age of criminal responsibility, after Chamber President Hugo Motta opened plenary proceedings, blocking committee consideration. The session featured solitary obstruction by Psol and tepid resistance from the PT, while the opposition accused Lula’s allies of blocking the proposal to prevent Bolsonarists from exploiting potential dissent within the governing coalition to boost Flávio Bolsonaro’s 2026 presidential pre-candidacy.

item.title: Documentos mostram como Vorcaro enviou R$ 61 milhões aos EUA para bancar ‘Dark Horse’, aponta site
item.description: Documents revealed by The Intercept show that Daniel Vorcaro sent at least US$10.6 million (R$61 million at the time's exchange rate) to the U.S. by May 2025 to finance the film 'Dark Horse', about the life of Jair Bolsonaro. The records include a payment spreadsheet and a SWIFT transfer confirmation, indicating funds were sent to Havengate Development Fund LP in Texas. Message exchanges between Vorcaro and Thiago Miranda suggest further disbursements were under discussion, reinforcing suspicions of illegal fund use in a cinematic project tied to the Bolsonaro family.

item.title: Ministro da Fazenda se reúne com Alcolumbre para tentar conter pauta-bomba de R$ 270 bilhões
item.description: Finance Minister Dario Durigan met with Senate President Davi Alcolumbre to try to block proposals with a fiscal impact exceeding R$ 270 billion, including rural debt renegotiation (R$ 120 billion), full retirement for health agents (R$ 99 billion), and a new minimum wage for doctors and dentists (R$ 47 billion). Despite tensions between Alcolumbre and the Lula government, Durigan is seen as one of the ministers with the best rapport with the senator. The measures are under Senate review and are viewed by the economic team as a threat to fiscal stability.

item.title: A nova pesquisa Nexus/BTG sobre a eleição presidencial, a 1ª após ameaça de tarifaço
item.description: The Nexus institute will release on Monday (15) a new presidential election poll with 2,000 interviews and a two-point margin of error. Commissioned by BTG Pactual, the survey will assess voter reaction to the U.S. threat of new tariffs on Brazilian goods, exploring whether voters blame Lula or Flávio Bolsonaro. In the May 25 poll, Lula led with 40% in the first round and would defeat Flávio Bolsonaro in a runoff by 47% to 43%.

item.title: Câmara analisa redução da maioridade penal, mas decisão antes da eleição é incerta, dizem analistas
item.description: The Constitution and Justice Committee of the Brazilian Chamber of Deputies is reviewing a constitutional amendment proposal to reduce the age of criminal responsibility to 16 years, with a favorable report from Deputy Coronel Assis. Experts describe the issue as electorally motivated and part of the broader public security debate, which is a central theme in the 2026 elections, while noting that youth involvement in crime has declined in recent years.

item.title: Ofensa a Motta: Conselho de Ética aprova parecer para suspender Pollon
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies' Ethics Committee approved a report recommending the three-month suspension of federal deputy Marcos Pollon (PL-MS) for offensive remarks against House President Hugo Motta (Republicanos-PB) during an event in Campo Grande. The vote was nine in favor and four against, marking the second time the committee has recommended Pollon's suspension, following a prior recommendation in May for his role in the Bolsonarist riot that occupied the Chamber's leadership board.

item.title: Conselho de Ética aprova suspensão de mandato de Marcos Pollon por 60 dias
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies' Ethics Council approved a 60-day suspension of Deputy Marcos Pollon's (PL-MS) mandate for making offensive remarks against Chamber President Hugo Motta. Pollon claims he is being punished for expressing his opinions and said he will appeal to the Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ). The final decision rests with the Plenary, requiring an absolute majority of 257 deputies.

item.title: Governo deve aprovar em 15 dias aumento de etanol para 32% na gasolina
item.description: Minister of Mines and Energy Alexandre Silveira announced that the government will discuss within 15 days raising the mandatory ethanol blend in gasoline from 30% to 32% (E32) at the next CNPE meeting. The measure, backed by the ethanol sector, aims to reduce fuel import dependence, particularly amid international instability like the Iran war, and strengthen Brazil's energy security.

item.title: Motta pede ao governo para retirar urgência de projeto sobre o fim da escala 6x1, após Câmara aprovar PEC
item.description: Chamber President Hugo Motta asked the Lula government to withdraw the urgency regime for the bill ending the 6x1 work scale, after a constitutional amendment (PEC) on the topic was approved in the Chamber. Motta said the government has not yet given a firm response, and the proposal includes two weekly days off and a reduction of the workweek from 44 to 40 hours over 14 months. The PEC now moves to the Senate, where Senate President Davi Alcolumbre has not yet defined its processing path.

item.title: ONS agiu de forma pontual e assertiva para evitar apagão, diz Silveira
item.description: Minister Alexandre Silveira stated that the ONS acted promptly and decisively by activating the emergency plan to reduce energy generation due to a sudden drop in demand from low temperatures, preventing a blackout. He emphasized that the government restored power within six hours after the August 2023 blackout and guaranteed energy security for the next decade, citing investments in hydroelectric plants and thermal contracts to ensure affordable tariffs.

item.title: Wellington Dias liga para João Campos após ruído sobre palanque em PE
item.description: Minister Wellington Dias called Recife Mayor João Campos after causing dissatisfaction by stating Lula might split his agenda between Campos’ and Governor Raquel Lyra’s platforms. Dias clarified his remarks were misinterpreted, emphasizing Lula will have support from both, and reaffirmed the PT’s backing of Campos’ candidacy. The calls came on Monday and Tuesday (Sept 8-9) after Campos complained to PT president Edinho Silva.

item.title: Ala do TSE tenta encontrar 'meio termo' para decisão de Nunes Marques que suspendeu pesquisa eleitoral
item.description: A faction of Brazil's Superior Electoral Court (TSE) is seeking a 'middle ground' regarding the decision by court president Kassio Nunes Marques to suspend the release of the Atlas Intel poll following a request from Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL). The move sparked internal debate over balancing free speech and electoral integrity. Supporters of a compromise argue for refining the decision to avoid setting overly restrictive precedents while maintaining oversight of electoral polls.

item.title: Cármen Lúcia diz que IA ameaça liberdade do voto e impõe desafios inéditos à Justiça Eleitoral
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Cármen Lúcia warned that artificial intelligence poses an unprecedented threat to voting freedom, as its rapid spread of synthetic content undermines voters’ autonomy and destabilizes democratic processes. She emphasized that AI goes beyond misinformation, directly impairing citizens’ ability to form free and critical convictions, particularly targeting women in politics. Her remarks came as Brazil’s Electoral Justice prepares for the first presidential election shaped by widespread generative AI use.

item.title: Ao vivo: Flávio Bolsonaro participa da Bahia Farm Show
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), a pre-candidate for the Presidency of the Republic, is participating live at the Bahia Farm Show 2026 in Luís Eduardo Magalhães, BA, starting at 3:30 p.m. on Tuesday, June 9, 2026. The event brings together over 500 agribusiness exhibitors showcasing innovations in machinery, inputs, and rural technologies. A live stream is available as indicated in the content.

item.title: Conselho de Ética aprova suspensão de deputado que ofendeu Hugo Motta
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies' Ethics Council approved a two-month suspension of Marcos Pollon (PL-MS) for calling House President Hugo Motta a 'bosta' and 'short guy at 1 meter and 60'. Pollon may appeal to the Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ), and if both appeals are denied, he could lose his mandate for up to four months. The insults occurred during a Bolsonarist rally in August 2025, when he also participated in the occupation of the Chamber's directing board.

item.title: Vorcaro enviou envio dinheiro aos EUA para filme de Bolsonaro, diz site
item.description: Intercept Brasil revealed that businessman Daniel Vorcaro, founder of Banco Master, sent nearly US$24 million to the U.S. to finance the film 'Dark Horse', about Jair Bolsonaro’s political trajectory, via Havengate Development Fund LP, a fund linked to Paulo Calixto, lawyer for Eduardo Bolsonaro. Documents show delayed payments and messages between Vorcaro and Thiago Miranda indicating new disbursements were being negotiated in August 2025, suggesting the total transferred may exceed the US$10.6 million already recorded. Flávio Bolsonaro did not respond to a request for comment.

item.title: Caiado diz que definição de candidato a vice ficará para o período das convenções partidárias
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) stated that the decision on his vice-presidential running mate will be made only during the party convention period, between July 20 and August 5, 2026. He said he is in dialogue with various names, including Silvia Abravanel and Romeu Zema, but has not closed any decision, emphasizing that the campaign's focus should be on public security and corruption, not the ticket composition.

item.title: EUA “têm toda razão”, diz Caiado sobre PCC e CV
item.description: Former Goiás governor and presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD-GO) stated that the United States 'are entirely justified' in imposing a 25% tariff on Brazilian exports, citing the USTR report based on Section 301 of the 1974 Trade Act. He linked the decision to the activities of criminal factions such as PCC and CV in Brazil, arguing that the U.S. measure is a legitimate response to insecurity and the perceived risk in Brazil's business environment.

item.title: Conselho de Ética da Câmara aprova parecer que recomenda suspensão de Marcos Pollon por três meses
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies' Ethics Committee approved, by a vote of 9 to 4, a report recommending a three-month suspension of Deputy Marcos Pollon (PL-MS) for making offensive remarks against Chamber President Hugo Motta during a rally in Campo Grande. Pollon criticized the lack of scheduling for an amnesty bill related to the January 8 coup attempt and used personal insults, including a reference to Motta's height. He may still appeal to the Constitution and Justice Committee before the final decision is made by the plenary.

item.title: Presidente do PT evita criticar decisão de Nunes Marques que suspendeu pesquisa a pedido de Flávio Bolsonaro: ‘Deve ter fundamento’
item.description: Edinho Silva, president of the Workers' Party (PT), refrained from criticizing TSE Minister Kassio Nunes Marques' decision to suspend the AtlasIntel poll on Flávio Bolsonaro, stating that 'he must have grounds' and that judicial decisions should be respected. He also advocated for political-electoral and judicial reforms to bring institutions closer to society, denying that the PT prioritizes term limits for supreme court ministers, despite Lula having previously supported the idea.

item.title: Governo deve aprovar aumento de etanol na gasolina de 30% para 32%, diz Silveira
item.description: Minister of Mines and Energy Alexandre Silveira announced he will submit to the CNPE a proposal to increase the anhydrous ethanol blend in gasoline from 30% to 32% (E32), with analysis expected in the next two weeks. The measure aims to reduce dependence on imported gasoline, potentially eliminating it, and mitigate the impact of the Middle East war on fuel prices, while supporting decarbonization. The government estimates the change will cut external gasoline purchases by about 500 million liters per month.

item.title: MP que amplia Minha Casa, Minha Vida é prorrogada
item.description: The Senate president extended by 60 days MP 1.350/2026, which expands the Minha Casa, Minha Vida program to include families earning up to R$13,000 (brackets 3 and 4) and increases the maximum financed property value. Signed by Lula, the measure reduces bank risk through FGHab and aims to ease credit access. The Congress also declared the end of MP 1.329/2025, which had allocated R$59.3 million to the Ministry of Social Development.

item.title: Kassio Nunes Marques vê chance do TSE balizar pesquisas e evitar que levantamentos sejam usados como ringue na disputa eleitoral
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques says the ruling on suspending the AtlasIntel poll is a chance to set clear rules for electoral polling, preventing research from being used as a political battleground. He noted the poll, which showed a drop in support for Flávio Bolsonaro, had demonstrated political bias through statements by the institute's CEO, Andrei Roman, who linked the candidate to financial fraud schemes and questioned his electoral viability. Marques emphasized that polling institutes must comply with Electoral Justice rules and do not have unrestricted freedom to ask questions that could influence the election.

item.title: Jair Bolsonaro pede a Moraes para receber nora e netas em casa
item.description: Former President Jair Bolsonaro, under house arrest, requested authorization from Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes to receive visits from his daughter-in-law Fernanda Bolsonaro and his minor granddaughters at his Brasília residence on June 13, 2026, the date of Brazil's World Cup 2026 debut. The request was reported by Metrópoles. Bolsonaro is serving a 27-year-and-3-month sentence for attempted coup d'état, currently under temporary house arrest since March 27, 2026.

item.title: Lula se reúne com diretores da ANP no Planalto: na pauta atraso em subsídios do diesel e novas regras do GLP
item.description: President Lula will meet with ANP directors at the Planalto Palace to discuss delays in diesel subsidy disbursements to importers and distributors, as well as new regulations for LPG (cooking gas). The meeting, scheduled for this Tuesday afternoon, is seen as strategic amid government pressure to control fuel prices.

item.title: ELEIÇÕES 2026: Nunes Marques suspende pesquisa indutiva sobre Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Nunes Marques suspended an opinion poll deemed inductive regarding Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, arguing the survey instrument could improperly influence voters. The ruling comes amid growing concerns about the legitimacy of suggestive polling questions in the context of the 2026 elections. The case has sparked debate over freedom of speech, the integrity of electoral polling, and the judiciary’s role in regulating democratic processes.

item.title: Nunes Marques dá 15 dias para Janones apresentar resposta a queixa-crime
item.description: Minister Nunes Marques of the Supreme Federal Court (STF) granted a 15-day deadline for federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) to respond to a criminal complaint filed against him by former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro. After the response is submitted, the case will be forwarded to the Attorney General's Office (PGR) for review.

item.title: Pesquisa Real Time Big Data mostra avanço de Flávio em um estado forte para a esquerda
item.description: Real Time Big Data poll in Espírito Santo shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (35%) and Lula (34%) in the first round, with Bolsonaro leading in the second round (48% to 43%). Despite the state being governed by Lula allies, the result reflects the historically conservative profile of capixaba voters, with Bolsonaro showing a negative oscillation since March but maintaining an advantage.

item.title: O recado que Nunes Marques quer dar para as campanhas com a suspensão de pesquisa eleitoral
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques defended the suspension of an electoral poll showing Flávio Bolsonaro's decline, stating the goal was to prevent polling institutes from becoming 'rings' used by opposing campaigns to attack candidates. He said the measure aims to regulate the role of polls in the 2026 elections.

item.title: Processo para anular doação de dinheiro e carro à Igreja Universal chega ao STF
item.description: The Brazilian Supreme Federal Court is virtually reviewing whether to uphold an order requiring the Universal Church of the Kingdom of God to return over R$ 500,000 and an imported vehicle donated by a follower, based on a São Paulo state court ruling that found the donation resulted from deception and exploitation of vulnerability. So far, Ministers Edson Fachin, Cristiano Zanin, and Alexandre de Moraes have voted to maintain the original decision, rejecting the church’s regimental appeal. The virtual judgment is expected to conclude by next Monday, June 15, 2026.

item.title: PSB espera fala pública de Lula para resolver campanha em Pernambuco
item.description: PSB leaders are awaiting a public statement from President Lula (PT) endorsing João Campos, former mayor of Recife, for the Pernambuco governorship, hoping to resolve an internal impasse causing divisions between PT and PSB members. The lack of clarity is fueling political tensions in the state.

item.title: Efeito-Michelle pode pesar na decisão de Moraes sobre prisão de Bolsonaro
item.description: The defense of Jair Bolsonaro is preparing a request to extend his house arrest at the STF, citing ongoing health issues that originally justified the measure. Minister Alexandre de Moraes will decide whether to maintain or end the house arrest, with potential influence from former First Lady Michelle Bolsonaro, who has been actively involved in negotiations and made public gestures to ease tensions with the justice.

item.title: Lula entregou a soberania do Brasil ao narcotráfico, diz Caiado
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, PSD pre-candidate for president, accused President Lula of delivering Brazil's sovereignty to drug trafficking by cutting R$4.3 billion from the Armed Forces budget and canceling border operations. He claimed that without military presence, organized crime will advance, especially in the Amazon, which he said has become the world's largest hub for cocaine export, and stated that the situation will change in January 2027.

item.title: Doria critica reunião de Trump com Flávio Bolsonaro e diz que não há vencedor em tarifaço
item.description: Former São Paulo Governor João Doria criticized the meeting between U.S. President Donald Trump and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro at the White House, calling it unprecedented for a sitting U.S. president to receive a Brazilian pre-candidate before official campaign registration. Doria noted the discussion included requests to designate PCC and Comando Vermelho as terrorist organizations, as well as trade tariffs, critical minerals, and Brazilian security. He argued that Trump’s tariffs harm both Brazil’s economy and its political leaders — Lula and Bolsonaro alike — producing economic loss without electoral benefit.

item.title: Parcela das dívidas dos partidos é 40% menor que a paga pela população
item.description: Bill 4.822/2025, approved by the Chamber of Deputies on May 19, 2026, allows political parties to pay electoral fines in up to 15 years, drastically reducing immediate financial impact. While families earning up to one minimum wage spend an average of 29.7% of their income (R$419/month) on debt, parties could repay fines of up to R$30,000 in 180 installments of about R$166 — roughly 40% less than the average population payment.

item.title: A reação de Lula ao alerta dos evangélicos e o papel de Janja na estratégia
item.description: President Lula faces persistent resistance from evangelical voters, a central challenge for his 2026 re-election bid. The PT released a letter targeting religious groups not for mass reconquest, but to reduce resistance and reopen dialogue, acknowledging historical estrangement from this segment. First Lady Janja plays a key role in this strategy, leading engagements with religious communities, especially evangelical women, though her reach remains limited among more conservative voters.

item.title: Justiça mantém condenação a homem que zombou da morte de neto de Lula
item.description: São Paulo's Court of Justice upheld the conviction of Hudson Luiz da Cruz de Menezes in second instance, who in 2019 posted on social media mocking the death of Arthur Araújo Lula da Silva, grandson of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The ruling confirms civil liability for moral damages resulting from the act.

item.title: Trump vira protagonista da disputa eleitoral entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Donald Trump has become a central figure in Brazil's 2026 presidential election, praising Lula while openly supporting Flávio Bolsonaro, including designating PCC and CV as terrorist groups and threatening tariffs. Lula relies on a personal rapport with Trump to reduce potential damage, while Bolsonaro’s allies view Trump as a strategic asset for their security-focused campaign. Polls predict a tight runoff between the 80-year-old incumbent and the 45-year-old senator.

item.title: A estratégia do PT para conter danos com o segmento evangélico
item.description: The PT held an event with progressive pastors and released a document aimed at reducing resistance among Brazil’s evangelical electorate, which makes up 27% of the population and has increasingly aligned with the right. The strategy seeks to distance the party from the politicization of religion, criticizing figures like Silas Malafaia and associating right-wing leaders with the label 'merchants of faith', while emphasizing the PT’s presence in marginalized communities and shared social values with believers.

item.title: Crusoé: Censura de Nunes Marques é Direito Xandônico com sinal trocado
item.description: The Crusoé article, published on O Antagonista, criticizes the TSE's actions under Alexandre de Moraes during the 2022 elections, alleging selective censorship against content unfavorable to Lula, including blocking a Brasil Paralelo documentary about the stabbing of Bolsonaro. It claims this interference unfairly benefited Lula's candidacy.

item.title: Longe da liderança em Minas, Simões acha 'mais conveniente' Zema ser vice de Flávio ou não disputar o Planalto
item.description: Minas Gerais Governor Mateus Simões (PSD) said it would be more convenient for his re-election if Romeu Zema (Novo) did not run for president or ran as Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) vice president, as it would avoid a runoff in the state. Simões took office after Zema's resignation but struggles in polls, ranking fourth with 4% voter intention, while Cleitinho (Republicanos) leads despite not confirming candidacy. He emphasized he cannot ask Zema to withdraw due to loyalty, as Zema had chosen him as successor.

item.title: Presidente do PT evita criticar decisão de Nunes Marques sobre pesquisa: ‘Deve ter fundamentos’
item.description: PT president Edinho Silva refrained from directly criticizing TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques' monocratic decision to suspend the AtlasIntel/Bloomberg electoral poll, stating the decision 'must have grounds' and that the PT respects judicial rulings. He emphasized Lula's re-election as the priority in regional alliances, even if it overrides local party interests. The seminar also launched a debate on judiciary reform focused on strengthening the CNJ, not necessarily to be included in Lula's government program.
